text:
Sasha: Quick sync — after the weekend outage I want to tighten postmortem follow-ups: clearer owners, timeline checkpoints, and a comms cadence.
Ravi: Totally. We had ~8 open action items and no clear owner after 1 week.
Lena: Can we separate "owner who drives" vs "owner who approves"? reduces churn.
Sasha: Good call. Proposal: IC (short-term coordinator), Remediation Owner (long-term executor), and Review Owner (approves closure).
Tom: Suggested timeline: T0=declare; T+24h=assign rem owner + summary; T+72h=plan + ETAs; T+7d=progress check; T+21d=verification; T+30d=closure & pattern review.
Priya: For comms: status updates every 6h while critical, then daily until T+72h, then weekly in-thread until closure. Post a customer-facing blurb within 72h if impacted. cc:comms/legal for regulated customers.
Sasha: Ops-bot should create cards and nudge owners at T+24h, T+72h, T+7d, T+21d, T+30d. If no ETA within 48h of assignment mark as "needs attention".
incident-bot: Ops-bot: reminders scheduled for thread 1900007777 at T+24h, T+72h, T+7d, T+21d, T+30d. Items without ETA after 48h will be flagged NEEDS_ATTENTION.
Ravi: Acceptance criteria for closing an action: remediation owner confirms fix deployed, attach smoke-test link or runbook steps, postmortem doc updated, and Review Owner signs off.
Lena: For recurring incident detection: at T+30d, Research team runs a 30m pattern review. If matches >2 prior incidents open a pattern ticket.
Tom: IC rota: 2-week rotation among on-call leads. If IC goes OOO, auto-fallback to on-call manager. Require a 1-paragraph IC handoff posted in-thread.
Priya: Ops-bot: can we have a board view that groups by owner + stale flags? helps at-a-glance.
incident-bot: Ops-bot: board "Remediations Board" created with swimlanes by owner and a STALE lane for items with no update in 10d.
Sasha: I'll draft a one-pager runbook (roles, timeline, comm cadence, closure checklist, ops-bot config) and run a 30-day pilot. Volunteers?
Ravi: I'll pilot week 1.
Lena: I'll help with the closure checklist and pilot week 2.
Tom: Count me in for the pilot triage.
Sasha: Thanks — I'll post the draft in #eng-oncall tomorrow and enable the Ops-bot reminders for the pilot incidents.
